intent: Let a user move between pages of a large list or table, by page number, next/previous, or page size.
avoid_when: the full set is small enough to show at once
infinite scroll better fits the content type
a11y_contract: wrapped in `<nav aria-label="Pagination">`; every page control carries an explicit aria-label ("Page N", "Go to next/previous/first/last page") and the current page is marked `aria-current="page"`; decorative ellipsis is aria-hidden
responsive_contract: switches between a compact (prev/next only) layout and the full numbered control across the md breakpoint; one variant is hidden and the other shown depending on viewport
requires_data: total item/page count, current page, and a page-change handler
